answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before it can bid, with one active job allowed per deposit. Like boats needing berths at a jetty, agents need separate deposits even if they wander between tasks or mirror another agent’s profile. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities must immobilize $100,000, paying financing costs for the full lock period; creating names alone buys no capacity.
